vetSays.line: 🛡️ Blanca, Luke, Néstor and Boris met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Blanca, Luke, Néstor, Boris are hurt.
🛡️ Lamar, Blanca, Māui and Néstor met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Lamar, Blanca, Māui are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Lamar just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lamar, Luke, Elif and Boris met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Lamar, Elif, Boris are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Lamar, Māui, Boris and Dmitri met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Lamar, Māui, Dmitri are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wei just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nathan just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sari and Nathan met them at the door — 2 put down. Sari is hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.

⚠️ Two threats: Scarred The Ugly Beast and an eye-head (×4) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Esi just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Esi and Devon met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Devon is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ivy taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Ivy drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
The Scarred Big Ugly is on you — no warning, just teeth.
Scarred Big Ugly hits you for 3.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
The Scarred Big Ugly falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred Big Ugly!
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Big-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
The Pack-leader Big-Eyes falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Big-Eyes!
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Fyodor just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Fyodor met them at the door — 1 put down.
